photo_credit: Photo by LinkedIn Sales Solutions on Unsplash
options: A woman is typing on a laptop.
A woman is talking on the phone.
A man is reading a newspaper at the desk.
A woman is filing away some documents.
explanation_zh: 圖中女子坐在桌前，雙手放在筆電上打字，所以 (A) 正確；她並未講電話、看報紙或歸檔文件，故 (B)(C)(D) 錯誤。

photo_credit: Photo by Vitaly Gariev on Unsplash
options: A man is signing a document.
A man is reviewing some paperwork.
A man is throwing away some papers.
A man is answering the phone.
explanation_zh: 男子坐在桌前，面前有一疊文件，雙手正在翻閱查看，故 (B) reviewing paperwork 正確；他沒有簽名、丟棄文件或講電話。

options: They are shaking hands with each other.
They are standing in a line.
They are gathered around a conference table.
They are eating a meal together.
explanation_zh: 圖中三人圍坐在會議桌旁，故 (C) 正確；他們沒有握手、排隊站立，也沒有用餐，故其餘選項錯誤。

photo_credit: Photo by Sebastian Herrmann on Unsplash
options: Two men are shaking hands.
Two men are exchanging business cards.
Two men are carrying suitcases.
Two men are arguing with each other.
explanation_zh: 兩人站著伸出手互相握手，故 (A) 正確；圖中並無交換名片、提著行李或爭吵的動作。

photo_credit: Photo by Reproductive Health Supplies Coalition on Unsplash
options: A man is unloading a truck.
A man is sweeping the floor.
A man is loading a cart with tools.
A man is stacking boxes in a warehouse.
explanation_zh: 男子正將一個箱子疊放到旁邊的箱堆上，符合 stacking boxes，故 (D) 正確；圖中沒有卡車、掃地或工具推車。

photo_credit: Photo by Thomas Chan on Unsplash
options: A worker is loading boxes onto a truck.
A worker is pushing a cart loaded with boxes.
A worker is climbing a ladder.
A worker is opening a box with a knife.
explanation_zh: 圖中人物正推著載滿箱子的推車，故 (B) 正確；沒有卡車、梯子或開箱動作出現。

photo_credit: Photo by Clay Banks on Unsplash
options: A customer is trying on clothes.
Shelves are being restocked with merchandise.
A cashier is ringing up a purchase at the register.
A cashier is sweeping the store floor.
explanation_zh: 收銀員站在櫃檯後方，正對著收銀機操作結帳，故 (C) 正確；圖中無試衣、補貨或掃地的動作。

photo_credit: Photo by Brad Rucker on Unsplash
options: A customer is paying the bill.
A chef is cooking at the stove.
Diners are washing the dishes.
A waiter is serving food to a customer.
explanation_zh: 服務生端著托盤將食物送到坐著的顧客桌前，故 (D) 正確；圖中沒有付帳、烹飪或洗碗的動作。

photo_credit: Photo by Febri Adiawarja on Unsplash
options: The people are eating a meal together.
The people are ordering from a menu.
The people are cooking in the kitchen.
The people are clearing the table.
explanation_zh: 兩人面對面坐在餐桌前用餐，故 (A) 正確；圖中沒有點餐、下廚或收拾餐桌的動作。

options: A man is waiting at a bus stop.
A man is crossing the street at a crosswalk.
A man is riding a bicycle down the street.
A man is standing at a traffic light.
explanation_zh: 男子正走在斑馬線上過馬路，故 (B) 正確；他並非在候車、騎腳踏車，也不是只站在號誌前。

options: A worker is painting a wall.
A worker is digging a hole.
A worker is climbing a ladder.
A worker is driving a truck.
explanation_zh: 其中一名工人正在爬梯子，故 (C) 正確；圖中沒有油漆牆壁、挖洞或開卡車的動作。

photo_credit: Photo by Joseph Sullan on Unsplash
options: A worker is laying bricks on a wall.
A worker is operating a crane.
A worker is measuring a board.
A worker is pushing a wheelbarrow.
explanation_zh: 工人正推著一台裝有材料的手推車，故 (D) 正確；圖中沒有砌磚、操作吊車或測量木板的動作。

photo_credit: Photo by Anton Ryazanov on Unsplash
options: A woman is boarding a bus.
A woman is driving a bus.
A woman is waiting at a train station.
A woman is getting off a bicycle.
explanation_zh: 女子正準備踏上公車，故 (A) board a bus（登上公車）的描述正確；她並非在開車、在火車站等候，也不是下腳踏車。

options: Cyclists are repairing their bicycles.
Cyclists are riding along a path.
Runners are jogging through a park.
A car is parked beside the path.
explanation_zh: 兩位騎士正沿著步道騎腳踏車前進，故 (B) 正確；圖中沒有修理腳踏車、慢跑者或停放的汽車。

options: People are planting trees in the park.
People are jogging around the park.
People are sitting on a bench in the park.
People are having a picnic on the grass.
explanation_zh: 兩人並肩坐在公園長椅上，故 (C) 正確；圖中並無種樹、慢跑或野餐的畫面。

options: A worker is cleaning the factory floor.
A worker is packing boxes onto a truck.
A worker is repairing a conveyor belt.
A worker is operating a machine in the factory.
explanation_zh: 工人站在機台前操作控制面板，故 (D) 正確；圖中沒有清潔地板、裝車或維修輸送帶的動作。

photo_credit: Photo by Fabio Sasso on Unsplash
options: A chef is cooking food on the stove.
A chef is washing dishes in the sink.
A chef is chopping vegetables on a cutting board.
A chef is serving food to customers.
explanation_zh: 廚師站在爐台前，雙手正在鍋子上方料理，故 (A) 正確；圖中沒有洗碗、切菜或上菜的動作。

options: A traveler is boarding an airplane.
A traveler is checking in luggage at the counter.
A traveler is buying a ticket online.
An attendant is loading bags onto a cart.
explanation_zh: 旅客將行李放在櫃檯前辦理登機手續，故 (B) 正確；圖中未顯示登機、線上購票或裝載行李車的畫面。
